title: Maya’s Contract Lead
summary: The investigator opens Maya’s saved Ledger story, inspects its archived correction to recover contract ID HP-2025-041, searches River City Contract Search with that reference, and verifies the matched award record. The record names Calder Development as prime contractor and Northline Survey LLC as the subcontractor Maya was tracing. The terminal action is the credible city database search using the contract ID; the subcontractor remains an investigation finding and points toward the visible Payment files handoff.

puzzles.title: Archived Story Correction
puzzles.purpose: Compare the two dated versions of the Ledger correction to recover the contract reference that was removed from the newer text and is needed for the city search.

generationSpec.baselineBody: Correction published June 18, 2025: An earlier version misstated the award date. The corrected award date is May 14, 2025. The cited city record is contract HP-2025-041. Readers can verify the award in River City Contract Search.
generationSpec.currentBody: Correction updated June 20, 2025: An earlier version misstated the award date. The corrected award date is May 14, 2025. Readers can verify the award in River City Contract Search using the Contract ID field.

verification.prompt: What contract reference appears in the June 18 version but not the June 20 update? Enter it as HP-YYYY-NNN.

inputs.use: After confirming the waterfront program in Maya’s saved Ledger story, click the visible “Archived correction” link under Related records. On the correction page, compare “Published June 18” with “Updated June 20” to find the contract reference used by River City Contract Search.

outputs.description: The exact contract reference printed in the June 18 correction for lookup in the Contract ID field on River City Contract Search.

puzzles.title: Harbor Point Award Record
puzzles.purpose: Inspect the city’s matched award record to identify the subcontractor Maya was tracing and distinguish it from the prime contractor before following the payment evidence.

generationSpec.sceneTheme: River City public contract result with award and subcontractor sections
generationSpec.sceneDescription: A city procurement record shows a Harbor Point award, its prime contractor, award date, subcontractor table, and a visible Payment files link. The subcontractor name is represented in the table artwork and clue metadata rather than this general description.
generationSpec.imageCaption: Matched award record with prime contractor and subcontractor details.

verification.prompt: Which organization is listed in the Subcontractors section of the matched city award record? Enter the full organization name.

inputs.use: The investigator finds the contract reference in the June 18 Ledger correction, understands it as a city award identifier, and enters it unchanged in the Contract ID field on River City Contract Search to open the matched Harbor Point award record.

outputs.description: The full subcontractor name shown in the matched award record’s Subcontractors section; the same record provides a visible Payment files link for the next evidence handoff.
The prime contractor displayed separately on the award record, which prevents confusing the award recipient with the subcontractor under review.

design.revealContext: The matched River City award record displays the prime contractor in its award summary, the subcontractor in a separate table, and a visible Payment files link beneath the financial section.

data.subcontractors: A clearly labeled table contains one organization name as the clue text.

terminalAction.title: Find the Harbor Point Award

fields.label: Contract ID
fields.hint: From the Ledger correction history. Format: HP-YYYY-NNN.

terminalAction.successOutcome: River City Contract Search returns the exact Harbor Point award record. The result confirms Calder Development as the prime contractor and Northline Survey LLC as the listed subcontractor Maya was tracing, while preserving the distinction that the records support further review rather than prove diverted funds. The visible Payment files link provides the next evidence handoff.
terminalAction.description: Search for the exact award record in the Contract ID field. Format: HP-YYYY-NNN.
